policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: British Virgin Islands visa-free visits
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport holders may visit the British Virgin Islands visa-free for one month.
conditions: The BVI immigration authority stamps a one-month entry permission after arrival; it may be extended to six months.
Evidence of funds, accommodation and departure plans, passport validity, work and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Central African Republic advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish visitors obtain the required Central African Republic tourist visa before travel through the named mission route.
conditions: Use a biometric passport; the Polish MFA identifies the French Embassy in Warsaw as a tourist-visa route.
Airport entry, documents, security, health, onward travel and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish visitors are visa-subject, and Chad's current official notices make new visitor-visa applications exclusively electronic before travel.
conditions: Apply through Chad's official eVisa platform before travel; standard processing is 10 working days and express processing is 72 hours.
Approval, documentary, health, security and final border-admission checks remain applicable.

application.label: Chad official e-Visa platform
application.processingTime: 10 working days standard or 72 hours express.
steps: Submit the ordinary Polish-passport visitor application online before travel.
Travel only after issuance and retain the required supporting documents.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Comoros arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport visitors obtain Comoros' single-entry tourist visa at the airport.
conditions: Use a biometric passport valid at least six months; the single-entry tourist visa is valid for 45 days.
Return ticket, funds, accommodation address and final admission remain required.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport visitors register and pay online, then lodge the complete application at the Republic of the Congo Embassy in Paris before travel.
conditions: Use a biometric passport; online registration and payment alone do not issue the visa.
The Embassy in Paris receives the complete application; its consular decision, health requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Iran advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport tourists obtain Iran's visa at the Embassy in Warsaw; airport collection needs a prior visa promise and is not a visa on arrival.
conditions: Ordinary passport tourists may apply at Iran's Embassy in Warsaw for up to 30 days.
Airport collection requires an Iranian mission's prior visa promise and carriers may refuse boarding on that basis alone; land and sea crossings do not issue visas.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: federal Iraq electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish tourists may obtain a federal-Iraq visitor visa through the official e-visa system before travel.
conditions: This is the federal-Iraq tourist route; the Iraqi Kurdistan Region has a separately scoped online system.
Airspace, border crossings, security checks, documentary requirements and final admission can change without notice.

application.label: Iraq official eVisa system
steps: Apply for the federal-Iraq tourist visa through the e-visa system before travel.
Check live border and flight availability before departure.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Niger advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport visitors obtain Niger's required visa through diplomatic or consular posts, nearest Berlin.
conditions: A valid yellow-fever vaccination certificate and adequate funds are required.
Security authorization and escort requirements outside Niamey, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: South Sudan electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport visitors can use South Sudan's eVisa route, whose approved PDF is downloaded before travel.
conditions: Use a biometric passport valid for at least six months; temporary passports are excluded.
Download the approved eVisa PDF before travel and present it at entry; a Berlin-embassy route remains an alternative.

application.label: South Sudan official eVisa service
application.processingTime: The service says the PDF is available within 72 hours after approval.
steps: Create an account and submit the ordinary Polish-passport visa application online.
Download the approved eVisa PDF before travel and present it at entry.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport visitors obtain Sudan's visa through its Berlin Embassy or named Sudanese consular posts before travel.
conditions: Use a biometric passport; airport issuance is unavailable.
The visa is issued for 30 days and may be extended; a prior Israeli visa prevents Sudanese visa issuance.

policies.title: Polish ordinary passports: Syria arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Polish ordinary-passport visitors can obtain Syria's visa at named international airports and Lebanon or Jordan land crossings.
conditions: The Turkish land border is unavailable except to specified Syrian and Turkish categories; Warsaw embassy filing is currently unavailable.
Visa validity varies from 15 days to six months by purpose; security, operational, Israeli-document, carrier and final-admission restrictions remain separate.

The current Polish MFA profile says Polish visitors obtain the visa directly at named international airports or Lebanon and Jordan land crossings; the eVisa route is invitation-conditioned.
